def get_squares():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    squares = []
    for node in seg['nodes']:
        if node['color'] == 'S':
            b = node['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            squares.append((min(rows), min(cols)))
    squares.sort()
    return tuple(squares)

    seg = current_frame.segmentation

def get_squares():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    squares = []
    for node in seg['nodes']:
        if node['color'] == 'S':
            b = node['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            squares.append((min(rows), min(cols), node['pixels']))
    squares.sort()
    return squares
